Table of Messages
The Secretary of the House of Representatives shall table the following messages related to bills received from the National Assembly:-
(a) National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2081
(b) Tourism Bill, 2081
(c) Film Bill, 2082
